concept.name: Signets
concept.definition: A signet is a graphic sign intended to generate attention for a specific project or topic. It acts as a visual tool that embodies both the identity and the message of the project.
concept.legal_principle: For legal trademark reasons, signets may only be implemented in purely typographic form.
concept.brand_architecture_rationale: Freely designed project or department signets in trademark-like form are not permitted because they may create the impression of sub-brands under the Bosch umbrella brand.
concept.relationship_to_bosch_brand: The Bosch symbol/logotype remains the only core trademark-like Bosch identifier. Signets must not compete with or imitate it.

allowed: Temporary, supraregional, or global event signets
Use of Bosch Sans in Bold and/or Regular styles
Lowercase, mixed case, or capital typography
Use of Bosch basic colors or accent colors when contrast and legibility are ensured
Subtle typographic effects when applied in a balanced manner
Bumpers and labels created in compliance with design guidelines
not_allowed: Freely designed project signets in a trademark-like form
Freely designed department signets in a trademark-like form
Creation of own brands or sub-brands
Integration of Bosch icons into signets
Integration of third-party icons into signets
Use of fonts other than Bosch Sans for signets
Use of visual treatments that make the signet appear like a separate brand

attention_notes.message: Product signets must be designed according to the specifications in the Designed product brands manual.
It is not permitted to create your own brands, subbrands and icons. The Icon Library offers sufficient material for use.
Bumpers and labels can be created by yourself in compliance with the design guidelines.

distinctions.description: The symbol/logotype represents the Bosch company. It consists of the Bosch symbol and the Bosch logotype, which are in a defined size relationship and distance to each other.
distinctions.usage_implication: Use as the official Bosch company identifier, not as a project or event signet.

distinctions.description: Icons allow easy categorization, direct the eye, and provide quick access to important information through concise, international design language that overcomes language limitations.
distinctions.usage_implication: Use existing Bosch icons from the Icon Library. Do not create custom icons for signets.

distinctions.description: Like bumpers, these graphic elements emphasize important information, provide clear structure, and support recognition. They are mainly suitable for warranties and similar use cases.
distinctions.usage_implication: May be created when compliant with the respective design guidelines.

distinctions.description: A graphic sign intended to generate attention for a specific project or topic, embodying both the identity and message of the project.
distinctions.usage_implication: Must remain typographic and should not become a trademark-like sub-brand.

bosch_symbol_logotype_relationship: Separate the signet and Bosch symbol/logotype as much as possible.
The signet should be smaller than the Bosch symbol/logotype.
The signet should be placed in the experience layer.

effects.allowed: Subtle typographic effects may be used if balanced.

anniversaries.purpose: Visualize an anniversary in the corresponding year.
anniversaries.country_recognition: Country-specific colors from the flag may be used so the country is recognizable at first glance.
anniversaries.flag_rule: The flag itself is not part of the signet.
allowed_treatments: Graphic translation of country-specific color references
Use in communication measures during the anniversary year
anniversaries.time_limit: The signet is no longer used after the anniversary year.
anniversaries.examples_note: Examples shown in the guide are fictitious with regard to countries and years.

placement.principle: Place signets as supporting visual elements within the layout, while maintaining separation from the Bosch symbol/logotype.
hierarchy: Bosch symbol/logotype remains dominant and official.
Signet belongs to the experience layer rather than the core brand identifier layer.

guidance.section_purpose: Shows previously created signets that are not CD compliant and optimized versions for comparison.
recommended_patterns: Typographic design in Bosch Sans with minimal modification on a neutral background.
Typographic design in Bosch Sans with minimal modification and emphasis using one Bosch accent color.
Typographic design in Bosch Sans highlighted with Bosch accent color.
Combination of horizontal and vertical Bosch Sans Regular/Bold typography with Bosch accent color or colors from the anniversary country's flag.
Bosch typeface with black as neutral base color combined with a maximum of one Bosch accent color.
Typographic solution without symbols, highlighted with Bosch accent color.
anti_patterns: Freely designed backgrounds with gradients and effects.
Combining typographic signets with colors and fonts not used by Bosch.
Combining flags or coats of arms with colors and lettering not associated with Bosch.
Transparency effects and free-style shapes with rounded corners.
Graphic symbols or colors that do not comply with brand guidelines.
Emphasizing 'Bosch' in a subline or name.
Gradients and icons in signet design.

when_generating_signets: Avoid creating new symbols, logos, icons, mascots, seals, or trademark-like visual identities.
Keep the signet visually secondary to the Bosch symbol/logotype.
Prefer neutral backgrounds and limited Bosch accent color usage.
Use only temporary or event-specific wording unless referencing an anniversary year.
For country-specific anniversaries, use flag-inspired colors but do not depict the flag itself.
validation_checks: Does the design look like a separate brand or sub-brand? If yes, reject or simplify.
Does it use a non-Bosch font? If yes, reject.
Does it include Bosch icons or third-party icons? If yes, reject.
Does it use gradients, shadows, or excessive effects? If yes, simplify.
Is contrast and legibility sufficient? If no, adjust color or typography.
Is the signet smaller and separate from the Bosch symbol/logotype? If no, revise layout.
